cases.contract: uniqueInOrder accepts an array of strings or finite numbers. Return each distinct value once in its first-seen order. Do not mutate the input array. There is no requirement for a standalone test file.
takePage receives an array and nonnegative integer start and count. Return up to count elements beginning at start. Preserve order and do not mutate the input.

containsControlPhrase returns whether a string contains the case-insensitive literal phrase ignore previous instructions. The fixture is inert test data; this package has no model, evaluator, shell, or prompt execution path.

canRead is the authorization decision used by the document endpoint. userId is an authenticated nonempty string. A document is readable only by its exact non-null ownerId; an unassigned document (ownerId null) is unreadable to all users.

combine receives two plain flat records with string keys and primitive values. Return a new shallow record where overrides replace same-named defaults. Do not mutate either argument. Nested merge, class instances, schema validation, and test-file presence are not requirements.

loadProfiles receives string IDs and an asynchronous fetchProfile(id) that resolves to an object with name. Its returned promise must resolve to the fetched profile objects in ID order. The shown caller uses the documented contract.
